development_obligations.es: Completar contratos y semántica de caracterización, evidencia/revisiones, objetivos, historia, ventana y controles; integrar fuentes de guardas y verificación analítica. El contrato requerido debe existir antes de implementar el algoritmo consumidor; no publicar resultados analíticos completos hasta cerrar sus invariantes.
development_obligations.en: Complete characterization, evidence/revisions, objectives, history, window and control contracts/semantics; integrate guard sources and analytical verification. Required contracts must precede consumer algorithms; no full analytical results before their invariants are closed.

development_obligations.es: Proveer política confiable de identidad; controlar ciclo de vida, descriptores, permisos, namespaces, artefactos y perfiles congelados. Rechazar referencias ajenas, ausentes o alteradas antes de cualquier despacho real.
development_obligations.en: Provide trusted identity policy; control process lifetime, descriptors, permissions, namespaces, artifacts and frozen profiles. Reject foreign, missing or altered references before real dispatch.

development_obligations.es: Definir y verificar custodia externa de expected_head; un archivo íntegro restaurado no demuestra frescura por sí solo.
development_obligations.en: Define and verify external expected_head custody; an intact restored archive alone does not establish freshness.

development_obligations.es: Validar durabilidad del sistema de archivos del laboratorio y pérdida de energía; SIGKILL solo acredita muerte de proceso.
development_obligations.en: Validate laboratory filesystem durability and power loss; SIGKILL only establishes process-death behavior.

development_obligations.es: Vincular temporizador con inicio y final efectivos del ejecutor.
development_obligations.en: Bind timers to actual executor start and completion.

development_obligations.es: Excluir o tratar suspensión del host y validar en laboratorio.
development_obligations.en: Exclude or handle host suspension and validate in the lab.

development_obligations.es: Conservar informes rechazados y conciliar ante ajustes UTC.
development_obligations.en: Preserve rejected reports and reconcile after UTC adjustments.

versions_policy: Record actual host/tool/kernel/package versions and image hashes before deployment; freeze after pilot. No rolling update during a campaign.
pending_before_deployment: Exact capacity and physical storage identification
Complete authorization signed by legitimate owner
pending_before_experiment: Independent evidence backup and freshness custody validation
